text: do the extraction, keep F2 behavior identical
resolution: Extracted the V24 placed-build-piece renderer out of the 2000-line PlayRoute into three shared editors/build/ modules so the coming iso authoring pane draws walls with the SAME renderer F2 uses (one renderer, change-once). pieceMeshes.tsx holds pieceVisualShapes + VisualBox/Ramp/ShapeMesh + PlacedPieceMeshes + RampSlabGeometry + MATERIAL_LOOK; buildUi.ts holds BUILD_UI + CAMERA_OCCLUSION_TUNING; placeFreezeProbe.ts holds perfMs + the place-freeze probe helpers. PlayRoute re-imports all of them. F2 behavior is identical by construction: every definition moved VERBATIM, the editorTunables().register() live-tuning side-effects stay in PlayRoute referencing the imported objects, and the global probe sequence is preserved. Verified the hmsc-int cart bundles clean (esbuild exit 0) and PlayRoute's diff is pure extraction (24 ins / 450 del, no other lane's work mixed in). Foundation isoStage.ts (the iso camera) committed alongside.
